# Juan Cruz-Benito

> Quantum+AI Manager at IBM Research. PhD in Computer Engineering (University of Salamanca, 2018). Works at the intersection of quantum computing, machine learning, and open source.

Juan Cruz-Benito researches and develops AI-based systems for quantum computing and other complex problems. His work spans quantum computing, machine learning, and open source software. He holds IBM Master Inventor status, has authored 80+ publications, and received the 2019 SCIE-BBVA Award for best young researcher in Computer Science in Spain.

## Key pages

- [About](https://juancb.es/): Bio, education, interests, and contact details.
- [Publications](https://juancb.es/publications/): 80+ peer-reviewed papers and articles on AI, quantum computing, and open source, going back to 2013.
- [Projects](https://juancb.es/projects/): Open-source projects, including AI tooling for Qiskit.
- [Talks](https://juancb.es/events/): Conference talks and invited lectures.
- [CV (PDF)](https://juancb.es/uploads/juan-cruz-benito-cv.pdf): Two-page CV covering experience, selected publications, patents, awards and talks.

## Featured projects

- [Qiskit Code Assistant](https://juancb.es/projects/qiskit-code-assistant/): Family of open-source LLMs (8B-24B) for quantum code generation, plus the Qiskit HumanEval benchmarks.
- [Qiskit MCP Servers](https://juancb.es/projects/qiskit-mcp-servers/): Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connecting AI assistants and agents to IBM Quantum services.
- [qiskit-ibm-transpiler](https://juancb.es/projects/qiskit-ibm-transpiler/): AI-powered quantum circuit optimization library, ranked 3rd in the Unitary Foundation 2025 Survey with 981K+ downloads.
- [Qiskit Gym](https://juancb.es/projects/qiskit-gym/): Reinforcement learning environments for quantum circuit synthesis.

## Recent publications

- [Large Language Model-Guided Discovery of Weight-Five Bivariate Bicycle Codes](https://juancb.es/publications/2026-weightfivebivariatebicyclecodesllm/) (arXiv:2610.06623, 2026): Extends LLM-guided program evolution to weight-five bivariate bicycle quantum LDPC codes, with exact distance certificates, structural analysis and random-search controls.
- [Linter-Guided Repair of Quantum Code Smells](https://juancb.es/publications/2026-linterguidedrepairquantumcodesmells/) (SaTQuML Workshop, NeurIPS 2026): Uses LLMs to repair quantum-specific code smells in Qiskit benchmarks without breaking functional correctness.
- [Evolutionary Discovery of Bivariate Bicycle Codes with LLM-Guided Search](https://juancb.es/publications/2026-bivariatebicyclecodesllm/) (arXiv:2606.02418, 2026): LLM-driven program evolution plus an independent validation pipeline for discovering quantum LDPC codes.
- [Qiskit QuantumKatas](https://juancb.es/publications/2026-qiskitquantumkatas/) (arXiv:2605.27210, 2026): A 350-task Qiskit benchmark, adapted from Microsoft's QuantumKatas, for evaluating LLMs on quantum programming.
